text:
Sam: Heads-up — CI flaky on rerank evals for the new quantized embedder. Seen in two builds in a row. :eyes:
Maria: which metric/test?
Sam: ndcg_topk_runner test. It fails when we enable `candidate_sampling_weights` in the harness config. Sometimes NDCG drops to 0.0 for some queries.
Jordan: can you paste the failure log?
Sam: sure — here's the failing assertion snippet:
```
AssertionError: ndcg@10: expected >= 0.30, got 0.0
Query id: sku_2345
Candidates: 20, weights applied
TopK: [3, 3, 3]  # ties after weighting
```
Maria: that smells like ties in scores are being broken nondeterministically by the runner sort. We recently changed the sampling to use `random.choices` with weights and didn't fix the seeding.
Lee: +1. Also the metric code assumes strict ordering; when duplicates occur the `rank` computation does `argsort` and `enumerate` which depends on stable sort but Python's sort is stable so it's weird. Could be different order between runs because we sample candidates with equal weights leading to different candidate sets.
Jordan: timeline: reproducer locally? If we can make a small script to hit the runner with deterministic RNG and the same weights, we can debug.
Sam: I made a tiny repro: a harness config and a short runner invocation. Repro steps below:
```
# config snippet
sampler:
  type: weighted
  seed: null  # <-- bug: seed not set in CI
  weights_key: candidate_sampling_weights
```
# command
pytest tests/eval/ndcg_runner_test.py::test_ndcg_with_weights -k sku_2345 -q
Run without seed -> intermittent failure. Set `seed: 42` -> deterministic pass/fail.
Maria: so two fixes: (1) normalize weights before sampling (ensure sum > 0 and scale to probabilities), (2) require deterministic seed in CI harness or make sampler accept `CI_JOB_ID`-based seed.
Lee: also update metric to use a tie-aware definition: when scores tie, average the rank positions (standard competition ranking) so ndcg isn't 0 just because order flipped. Example change in metric calc:
```
# old
ranks = {doc: i+1 for i, doc in enumerate(sorted_docs)}
# new (tie-aware)
# compute groups of equal scores and assign mean rank to group
```
Jordan: I'll sketch a PR that: normalizes weights, forces a seed env var in CI (`EVAL_SEED`), and swaps metric rank logic to tie-aware. Add unit tests for duplicate-score groups.
CI-bot: build 4721 failed: tests/eval/ndcg_runner_test.py::test_ndcg_with_weights — intermittent failure reproduced on runner-3
Sam: thanks. Jordan — please include a small synthetic dataset for the test that has repeated score ties and explicit `candidate_sampling_weights`.
Jordan: will do. Also will add a short note to the dashboard ingestion job: if we backfilled existing runs where ties occurred, we should flag those rolls as "tie-inflated" and skip auto-regressions.
Maria: good call. We should also add a lint rule in the harness config schema to require `seed` when `type: weighted` is used in CI mode.
Lee: I'll open a tiny schema PR for that.
Sam: timeline?
Jordan: aiming for a PR today (small changes), then run canary on the embedding-eval pipeline. If green I'll merge and backfill a week of runs.
Sam: sweet. After merge I'll disable flaky regression alerts for the affected metric until backfill completes. :thumbsup:
CI-bot: build 4724 queued for branch james/ndcg-ties-fix
Sam: thanks all — assigning followups: Jordan (PR + tests), Lee (schema), Maria (dashboard flags), Sam (mute alerts + monitor).
Maria: I'll add a short note to the eval-runbook about tie handling.
Lee: PR up: https://git.redwood.ai/p/ndcg-tiefix — draft, please review.
Jordan: reviewing now.
Sam: ping when merged and I'll watch the canary.
Maria: nice teamwork :tada:
